title: Bring in invoices from the Admin Dashboard
summary: How to add the invoices and credit notes you issue in the Admin Dashboard to your books, by linking its folder once or importing a file.

sections.heading: Ways to do this
paragraphs: Link the folder once, and new invoices wait on the Invoices page for one click. This is the easiest way.
Or import a file the Admin Dashboard wrote, when you want to bring one in yourself.

steps.text: Click Settings in the sidebar, and find the Admin Dashboard card.

image.description: The Admin Dashboard card in Settings: Shared folder: invoices, a note that both apps stay on this Mac, and the buttons Change folder and Stop linking.

steps.text: Click Choose folder…, and choose the folder the Admin Dashboard writes its invoices to.
Open Invoices. When new invoices have arrived, a message says how many, such as "2 new invoices arrived from the Admin Dashboard". Click Add to books.
Read the preview, then click the Import button. Nothing is added before you click it.
On the Invoices page, click Import file, and choose the file.
The preview says how many invoices are new, which are already in your books, which are a newer version of one you have, and any quotes, which are never added.

image.description: The Import invoices sheet: 4 new invoices, total $17,380.00 including $1,580.00 GST, 1 quote not imported, and the four invoices with Coastal Body Corporate marked new contact. Cancel and Import 4 invoices are below.

steps.text: Click the Import button, such as Import 4 invoices. Each invoice is added to your books, and a customer you did not have yet is saved as a contact.
The Invoices page shows what is Unpaid, Overdue and Paid in the last 30 days, and where each invoice is up to in words, such as Unpaid · due 12/12/2026 or Overdue · 30 days.

image.description: The Invoices page: Unpaid $10,780.00 3 invoices, Overdue $6,600.00 1 invoice, Paid last 30 days, then each invoice with its date, customer, total, GST and status.

steps.text: Home's to-do list says when an invoice is overdue.
On the cash basis, an invoice's GST goes into your BAS in the quarter it is paid, not when you issue it.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: The file could not be brought in: it was not written by the Admin Dashboard, or it has a mistake. The message names the part that is wrong.
An invoice is not added because its date is in a locked quarter: a closed quarter cannot change. Issue a credit note or a new invoice in the Admin Dashboard instead.
The linked folder cannot be read: it was moved or renamed. Choose it again in Settings.
Importing the same file again adds nothing twice.
